title: Pinaka UQS Core — exam-agnostic item contract (v1)
description: TIER: CORE. The structural contract shared by every exam. Exam-specific narrowing — the exam value, id namespace, option count, difficulty scale, ext shape, asset policy — lives in a Profile schema that composes this one via allOf + $ref (see profiles/<exam>/). This file expresses STRUCTURAL invariants only. Cross-record invariants (content_hash recompute, pack-level uniqueness, tests[] and misconception referential integrity against a Profile's taxonomy and canon, asset sanitization) are enforced by the shared validator, not here, because JSON Schema cannot express them. Core changes rarely; the Profile absorbs per-exam variation. Surface: single_best, numeric_entry. Stimulus/grouping, multi_select are deferred until an exam needs them.

explanation_sections.description: Structured teaching sections shown after an answer (ADR 0017). Optional; when present, all four sections are present. punchline: one or two sentences naming why the keyed answer wins, always visible in the UI. approach: how to attack this question type from a cold read. lesson: the transferable take-home rule. timing: how long this should take and what to cut first. Per-option teaching lives in per_option_rationale, not here. None of these fields enter the content hash; identity is the problem, not the teaching.

explanation_kind.description: The reasoning archetype this item's teaching follows (ADR 0023), exam-agnostic. It sets, per archetype, what explanation_sections.approach must foreground and how per_option_rationale proves the key. derivation: an algebraic step-chain. formula_selection: name the formula and why this one, then map every given to a variable with its period and unit. counting: classify order and repetition, decompose, then count. deductive_trace: constraint logic with no formula; each distractor's rationale must name the violated clue, because the rationales are the proof. model_compute: identify the model or distribution and state assumptions, then compute. concept: state the definition or property and contrast the confusable one. Optional until the pack is backfilled, then required. Does not enter the content hash.

ext.description: Per-exam extension. Shape validated by the exam Profile (additionalProperties enforcement lives there, not here). See ext_ca in the CA Foundation QA Profile.

allOf.description: machine_verified requires solution to be present. An item cannot claim machine_verified unless its executable solution is recorded.

license.description: SPDX license identifier. CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 is the standard shipped license. LicenseRef-pinaka-internal-unreleased is permitted only when verification_status is not published (enforced by Tier-2 UNPUBLISHABLE_LICENSE check).

empirical.description: Machine-filled IRT and telemetry block. All numeric fields are bounded to their domain. Never authored by hand.

difficulty_b.description: IRT difficulty (ability-scale logits). Range [-6, 6] covers all practical items.

discrimination_a.description: IRT discrimination parameter. Negative discrimination indicates a problem item.

p_value.description: Proportion of correct responses. Probability in [0, 1].

avg_seconds.description: Mean solve time in seconds. Capped at 3600 (1 hour) to bound outliers.

community_rating.description: Community quality rating on a 1..5 scale.

solution.description: Optional executable solution. Required when verification_status is machine_verified. The file at path (relative to the pack root) must exist and be non-empty (enforced by Tier-2 SOLUTION_FILE_MISSING check). Execution is a later task (W3-1).

language.description: Programming language of the solution script.

path.description: Relative path within the pack to the solution .py file, e.g. solutions/arn_caf_qa_000001.py
